name: Kusmic's Pathfinder
description: Solve, watch and edit level replays

re-scanner.name: RE Scanner (background capture)
re-scanner.description: Continuously capture the REAL engine while you play: mechanics (orbs/pads/portals/toggles), move-trigger object motion, per-frame physics, and level parameters. Data is written to GDMod_*.txt in your Documents folder to reverse-engineer the game. Off by default.

jump-probe.name: Jump Probe (sub-pixel physics capture)
jump-probe.description: Hooks PlayerObject::updateJump and records the engine's own state before and after EVERY 240Hz physics step, at full 17-digit precision: y, m_yVelocity, m_gravity, m_gravityMod, m_yStart, m_speedMultiplier, size, ground/slope/dash flags. This is the data that lets a constant be derived exactly instead of fitted. Writes testlevel/GDMod_jump_<id>.txt. HIGH VOLUME (~10 MB per minute of play) — turn it on for one focused run, not permanently. Off by default.

engine-trace.name: Engine Trace (per-function state capture)
engine-trace.description: Engine-decoding program. Hooks every in-scope PlayerObject gameplay function (update, updateJump, postCollision, collidedWithObjectInternal, collidedWithSlopeInternal, hitGround, didHitHead, flipGravity, ringJump, bumpPlayer, propellPlayer, the 7 mode toggles, togglePlayerScale, ...) and records the COMPLETE physics state of the player immediately before and after each call, plus its arguments. The field list is generated from the engine own code (tools/gen_snapfields.py). This is what the lockstep bench (test/lockstep.cpp) uses to prove a ported engine function exact, one call at a time. Writes testlevel/GDMod_enginetrace_<id>.bin. VERY HIGH VOLUME: turn it on for one short lab run only. Off by default.

show-inputs-ingame.name: Show Inputs In-Game
show-inputs-ingame.description: Show input bars when playing a level with a matching JSON replay.

bar-height.name: Bar Height
bar-height.description: Height of the input bars in pixels.

bar-y-position.name: Bar Y Position
bar-y-position.description: Vertical position of the bars from the bottom of the screen.

indicator-color.name: Indicator Color
indicator-color.description: Color for the player position indicator outline.

indicator-style-line.name: Indicator Style: Line
indicator-style-line.description: If enabled, the indicator is rendered as a vertical line. If disabled, it is rendered as a square.

background-color.name: Background Color
background-color.description: Color for the background strip behind the input bars.

accent-color.name: Accent Color
accent-color.description: Accent color for the mod UI.
